rules.name: CustomerIDRequired
rules.description: Every record must have a CustomerID.
rules.message: CustomerID is required and must not be blank.

rules.name: CustomerIDUnique
rules.description: CustomerID must be unique across all import rows.
rules.message: CustomerID must be unique — duplicate value detected.

rules.name: CustomerIDRegex
rules.description: CustomerID must follow the pattern CUST-XXXXXX.
rules.message: CustomerID must match the pattern CUST-XXXXXX (e.g. CUST-000001).

rules.name: FirstNameRequired
rules.message: FirstName is required and must not be blank.

rules.name: FirstNameMinLength
rules.description: First name must be at least 2 characters.
rules.message: FirstName must be at least 2 characters long.

rules.name: LastNameRequired
rules.message: LastName is required and must not be blank.

rules.name: LastNameMaxLength
rules.description: Last name must not exceed 100 characters.

rules.name: EmailRequired
rules.message: Email is required and must not be blank.

rules.name: EmailFormat
rules.description: Email must be a valid email address.
rules.message: Email must be a valid email address (e.g. user@example.com).

rules.name: StatusRequired
rules.message: Status is required and must not be blank.

rules.name: StatusAllowedValues
rules.description: Status must be one of the permitted values.
rules.message: Status must be one of: Active, Inactive, Pending.

rules.name: StatusNotDeleted
rules.description: The value 'Deleted' is not permitted in import files.
rules.message: Status 'Deleted' is not permitted in import files — use 'Inactive' instead.

rules.name: DateOfBirthFormat
rules.description: Date of birth must be in ISO 8601 date format.
rules.message: DateOfBirth must be in yyyy-MM-dd format (e.g. 1990-06-15).

rules.name: AgeRange
rules.description: Age must be a plausible value between 0 and 130.
rules.message: Age must be a number between 0 and 130.

rules.name: PhoneRequiredWhenContactMethodIsPhone
rules.description: Phone number is required when the contact method is 'Phone'.
rules.message: Phone is required when ContactMethod is 'Phone'.
